ml_job_overview.summary: The Professional Sales Manager at Gennext in Chennai is responsible for developing and executing sales strategies within the assigned market, ensuring the achievement of both financial and ethical objectives. This role supervises the distributor network, manages customer relationships, and drives brand presence across defined markets. The manager is expected to plan and execute business activities, monitor sales performance, and support new product launches. The position requires strong leadership in business planning, resource utilisation, and customer management to achieve divisional goals. The role is pivotal in fostering brand visibility and supporting the growth of Abbott and other competitor brands through effective trade activation and merchandising.
skills: Demonstrated ability to supervise and manage distributor networks.
Strong skills in business planning, resource utilisation, and customer management.
Experience in planning and executing sales strategies and trade activations.
Proficiency in monitoring sales performance and making mid-course corrections.
Ability to organise and conduct merchandising and sampling activities.
Experience in facilitating new product launches and market intelligence collection.
Capability to maintain customer lists and manage retailer inventory as per product profile and marketing strategy.
responsibilities: Responsible for developing and executing all sales strategies in the assigned market.
Take ownership of supervising and managing the distributor network to achieve sales objectives.
Play a key role in shaping customer management plans and approving expiry products and credit notes for distributors.
Collaborate cross-functionally to develop, execute, and plan resource utilisation.
Lead efforts to participate in strategy execution review meetings for alignment.
Deliver high-quality monthly, quarterly, half-yearly, and yearly sales targets by promoting products ethically.
Help drive innovation in business generation and development by organising camps and activations for brand visibility.
Take ownership of planning and conducting merchandising and sampling activities as per division strategy.
Responsible for facilitating new product launches by identifying and targeting customers in the territory.
Deliver high-quality coverage of doctors and ensure customer call averages meet divisional KPIs.

job.description:
As a Professional Sales Manager, you will be responsible for the development and performance of all sales strategies in assigned market. Further, you will drive primary sales, secondary sales and ensuring a brand presence in defined markets. You will supervise/manage the distributor network to achieve desired sales objectives thereby ensuring achievement of financial and ethical objectives of the division as per the business strategy.

 

To achieve this you will have the authority to develop your customer management plan, approve expiry products issue credit note for distributors under your control, recommending appointment and credit limits of distributors, develop, execute & plan your resource utilization and participate in Strategy Execution review meetings to ensure alignment.

 

You have a very important role to play in the Division's success.

 

Roles and Responsibilities in detail

Area Business Planning:

• Plan for the monthly and quarterly business.

• Plan for Trade activation business and overall sales

• Plan demand generation and fulfillment

• Monitor actual Sales and mid-course corrections and inputs to reduce variance against expectations

• Prescription audit for Abbott brands and other competitors brands

• To create and update the customer list having a specified number of doctors/chemists (Trade) as per the therapy/product requirement and maintain the same in physical/electronic format.

• Identifying potential town and appointing distributor and customers (trade) in line with the business philosophy

 

Business generation & development:

• Achieve monthly, quarterly, half-yearly and yearly Sales target by promoting companies product ethically to customers as per the business plan

• Having science base discussion with Doctor and chemist for promotion of the product in the clinic and at chemist place

• Organizing Camps (CME) as per the division strategy and customers need

• To carry out activations across trade and clinics for brand visibility

• To plan and conduct merchandising and sampling activity as per Division strategy.

• Facilitate the process of successful new product/products launch in the territory by undertaking correct identification and targeting customers for the new product, meet them at predetermined intervals, effective in clinic/trade promotion and feedback to the company

• Execute the customer management plan to ensure that all the customers are covered as per the plan and meet minimum KPIs as follows:

a. 100% coverage of Doctors.

b. Customer Call average as per the customer management plan of the division/therapy.

c. Market intelligence collection, retailer level inventory management calls as per the product profile and marketing strategy of the therapy/division.

 

Brand Management:

• Ensuring the visibility of Abbott brands on retailers outlet as a part of the brand promotion strategy

• To plan and attend Retail meets, Market Blitz etc for sales growth

 

#LI-DNI
